description: A three-masted oak sailing ship with white wool sails, rigging, a masthead banner, and an enclosed below-deck cabin. It reads as a coastal wow-moment landmark whether moored at a shore socket or set on open water, and gives players a boardable multi-level interior.

style_fit.rationale: Exactly the coastal hero centerpiece the Mediterranean/coastal demo brief calls for: a full ship silhouette with masts and sails that renders cleanly at 1.21.11 (no missing textures). Pairs with the cave-shore / pool tilesets. Boardable interior adds gameplay surface beyond pure scenery.
